driver: A stock splits into an active pool and a dormant residue, and one presentation constant recovered from closed conversions applies only to the residue, but units too young to have begun exiting look dormant, and the closed corpus never contained such units so it cannot tell them apart.

stump: A competent solver refuses the pooled share and the flow rate, counts the outstanding stock by print run, finds that taking every run with no recent destruction as the residue reproduces all four settled conversions at 0.1784, and files 24,066 thousand notes, booking five years of recent print runs as dormant.
